title: James Webb Space Telescope
summary: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) is the most advanced space observatory ever built, designed to explore the universe in infrared light. A collaborative project between NASA, ESA, and CSA, it was launched in 2021 and operates from the second Sun–Earth Lagrange point (L2). This article provides a comprehensive overview of its history, technology, scientific applications, and impact on astronomy.
